decisive_items: Multiple emboli of carcinoma cells in dermal and subcutaneous lymphatic vessels
response.rationale: Biopsy-proven dermal lymphatic carcinomatosis in a breast cancer patient indicates cutaneous metastasis; R2 is a clinical subtype but lacks the biopsy-specific support.

rejected.why: Radiation dermatitis does not explain lymphatic tumor emboli on biopsy.
Inflammatory breast cancer is a primary presentation, not a post-mastectomy recurrence with biopsy-proven dermal emboli.
